items.text: Your HR Self-Service Shouldn't Live Outside Your Microsoft Cloud

You've moved your business systems to Azure. Identity is centralized in Azure Active Directory, data lives in Dataverse, and analytics runs on Power BI. So why is your employee self-service portal still a standalone third-party app fighting the stack it is supposed to live in?
Two identity systems to manage
A standalone ESS means a second login for staff and a second directory outside Azure Active Directory for IT to maintain.
Data outside your Azure tenant
Employee records, leave balances, and expenses sit in a vendor database instead of your Dataverse and your Azure region.
Compliance you can't audit end to end
Your Azure workloads are SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR covered. A third-party ESS is not necessarily any of them.
No Power Platform reach
Standalone ESS data can't be surfaced in Power BI or automated with Power Automate without brittle, breakable connectors.
Contractors and deskless staff left out
Third-party bolt-ons were never designed for the phone-first workforce or the license-limited contractor.
An Employee Self-Service Layer Built Into Your Microsoft Cloud

Folio ESS runs on the same Microsoft cloud your business systems already sit on — hosted on Azure, identity from Azure Active Directory, data in Dataverse, extensibility through Power Platform, and deployed by a Microsoft Solutions Partner. Nothing is bolted on: every capability comes from a Microsoft service you already own, wrapped in an experience purpose-built for employee self-service.
Folio ESS App
The web and mobile self-service experience your people actually see — four role-based views over one shared data model.
Dynamics 365 Human Resources
Reads and writes employee records straight to Dataverse, so your HR data stays in a single system of record.
Power Platform
Extend screens, approvals, and reports with the same Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI tooling your teams already use.
Azure Active Directory
One corporate identity with conditional access and MFA — no second directory for IT to manage.
Microsoft Azure
Hosting, networking, and compliance in your own Azure region, inheriting the posture you already audit.
What You Can Use Folio3 ESS For
What Folio3 ESS Can Do
Every capability the app ships with maps to a Microsoft service you already run — no new vendor infrastructure to procure, secure, or maintain.
Azure-Native Hosting
Deploys into your Azure environment with the same regions, compliance posture, and network policies as the rest of your Microsoft workloads.
Azure Active Directory SSO
One login across Outlook, Teams, Business Central, and Folio ESS, with conditional access, MFA, and privileged identity management supported.
Native Dynamics 365 HR Integration
Reads and writes directly to Dataverse — no middleware, no nightly sync, no shadow database. Employee records stay where they belong.
Power Platform Extensibility
Build with Power Apps components, automate approvals with Power Automate, and surface HR data in Power BI without adding new infrastructure.
Cross-Platform Mobile App
Native iOS and Android apps with the same role-based experience as the web, signed in through Azure Active Directory on every device.
A Native Mobile App for iOS and Android

The mobile app is a first-class part of Folio ESS, not a mobile-web wrapper. It carries the same role model, permissions, and Azure Active Directory sign-in your workforce uses on the desktop into a form factor built for warehouses, construction sites, retail floors, and travelling staff.
Instant approval alerts
Approval requests are pushed to a manager's phone the moment they are filed, so nothing waits for someone to open a laptop.
Camera capture on the go
Snap receipts, IDs, and compliance documents straight from the phone camera into the right employee record.
Works with a weak signal
Read access to key records stays available when there is no reliable data connection on site.
Identical role and access rules
The same permissions and role model apply on mobile as on the web app, on every device.
Secured by Azure AD
Azure Active Directory sign-in with conditional access is enforced on mobile exactly as it is on the desktop.
Five Reasons Enterprise Buyers Choose It Over a Bolt-On
Runs where your other Microsoft workloads run
Same Azure region, same tenant, same operational model — no new vendor cloud to reason about.
Uses the identity you already manage
Azure Active Directory, conditional access, and multi-factor authentication out of the box.
Inherits your compliance posture
SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR covered by the underlying Azure and Microsoft services you already audit.
Extensible with Power Platform
Customize with the same low-code tools your teams already use for other Microsoft apps.
Delivered by a Microsoft Solutions Partner
Folio3 supports the app alongside your Azure, Business Central, and Power Platform work.
